summary: The /faq/ page is titled 'Property Finance FAQs' [b]. Per the search tool's summary [b] it covers commercial mortgages, development finance, bridging loans and property funding, with sections on buy-to-let, foreign national, Prime London, international and portfolio mortgages. Only one verbatim sentence from the page was surfaced: 'Most BTL products will max out at 75% LTV, requiring a deposit from the borrower of 25% of the property's value.' [b]. The seed (first-pass snippet) adds paraphrased FAQ content on HMO LTV (typically 75%, some lenders 80% in exceptional circumstances), Article 4 directions helping valuations, Consumer Buy-to-Let falling under FCA rules, the 40% owner/family occupation threshold making a loan regulated, non-resident lending needing stronger documentation / more conservative LTV / path-of-funds AML-KYC evidence, portfolio loans sitting alongside existing individual mortgages, a narrowed premium on portfolio products, sector-agnostic whole-loan providers (PBSA, hotels, BTR, industrial), some lenders accepting first-time HMO buyers with strong personal income and a clear management plan, and a 'network of over 800 lenders'. Search [a] (exact URL) did not return the FAQ page at all and only returned secondhand directory/profile pages; search [c] returned nothing about Silver Oak Capital (only other UK lenders' HMO criteria, ignored). The actual question wording, number of FAQ entries, page structure, CTAs and any FAQ on commercial mortgages/development/bridging remain unrevealed.
